definitions.explanation: Doing something without obtaining prior consent or notifying the appropriate person. Used to describe actions taken without the knowledge or approval of others.

examples.japanese: {無断|むだん}⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{困|こま}ります→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
{無断|むだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}らないで→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not take photos without permission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{著作物|ちょさくぶつ}→著作物：18133_chosakubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無断|むだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転載|てんさい}→転載：14359_tensai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Reposting someone else's work without permission is a legal violation.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {断|だん} (permission/refusal). Literally 'without asking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {無断|むだん} + noun: noun modifier ({無断|むだん}⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧)
- {無断|むだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + verb: adverbial ({無断|むだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無断|むだん}⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧: unexcused absence
- {無断|むだん}⟦{転載|てんさい}→転載：14359_tensai⟧: unauthorized reproduction
- {無断|むだん}⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: unauthorized use
- {無断|むだん}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧: unauthorized parking
- {無断|むだん}⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧: absence from work without notice

USAGE:
Frequently seen on signs ({無断|むだん}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}{禁止|きんし}→駐車禁止：09691_chuushakinshi⟧ — no unauthorized parking) and in workplace rules. Carries a tone of reproach — doing something {無断|むだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ is generally viewed negatively.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無許可|むきょか}: without a permit/license (more official/legal)
- {無断|むだん}: without telling/asking (interpersonal)
